437-950-4613.easyPrerequisites:
Sphinx's Disciple doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Fatestitcher is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.

437-950-4613.description:
Activate Sphinx's Disciple using Fatestitcher's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Fatestitcher's ability by tapping it, untapping Sphinx's Disciple
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, drawing a card.
Repeat.

151-2734-5261.easyPrerequisites:
To Arms! is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
151-2734-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.

Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of To Arms! without paying its mana cost.
Resolve To Arms!, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card
Repeat from step 2.

1278-3327-4508-6798.easyPrerequisites: Lightning-Rig Crew doesn't have summoning sickness.
1278-3327-4508-6798.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least two artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1278-3327-4508-6798.description:
Activate Lightning-Rig Crew by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure for each opponent dealt damage.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Dargo by paying {R} due to its cost reduction, including its commander tax.
Lightning-Rig Crew triggers, untapping it.
Resolve Dargo. Then, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat.

539-1491-4029-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

1231-3899-4826-6644.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Gravewaker by paying {5}{B}{B}, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten Treasure tokens that enter untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

222-527-4785-6495.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4785-6495.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Evereth twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
222-527-4785-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

803-2837-7827.description:
Cast Thorin by paying {3}{R}{W}.
When Thorin enters, it triggers, creating a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste due to Jinnie Fay.
When the Cat enters as a Dwarf due to Arcane Adaptation, Thorin triggers, creating a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste due to Jinnie Fay.
Repeat step 3.

Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Brigid
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Brigid
Repeat.

4631-4929-7743.description:
Activate Essence Depleter, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life

Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding at least {2}.
Repeat.

539-2416-3899-4552-7704.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Rise and Shine
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1636-5371-7290-7629.description:
Animate Hourglass of the Lost using Does Machines.
Activate Hourglass of the Lost's first ability by tapping it, adding {W} and putting a time counter on it.
Kate's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.
1636-5371-7290-7629.notes: Since Hourglass of the Lost will get infinite time counters, Kate Stewart's second ability can be used to make your creatures infinitely large.

703-4753-7149.description:
Cast Clever Impersonator by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Clever Impersonator into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Clever Impersonator dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Astral Dragon, gaining its abilities.
When Clever Impersonator enters, it triggers, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Put all but one of the Clever Impersonators into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Clever Impersonator tokens each trigger. Resolve a trigger, creating two token copies of itself, thus creating two copies of Moon with Astral Dragon's abilities, that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 5.
703-4753-7149.notes: The additional triggers can copy whatever noncreature permanent(s) you desire.

1719-7163-7172.description:
Activate Sunken Palace's second ability by paying {1}{U}, tapping it and exiling seven cards from your graveyard, adding {U}.
Put any triggered ability on the stack.
Holding priority, activate Mister Fantastic by paying {R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, ensuring to use the mana from Sunken Palace, targeting a triggered ability.
Sunken Palace triggers. Holding priority, activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Mister Fantastic.
Activate Mister Fantastic by paying {1}{R}{G}{W}{U} and tapping it, copying Sunken Palace's trigger twice.
Resolve the first Sunken Palace trigger, copying Mister Fantastic's ability, targeting a Sunken Palace trigger.
Resolve the Mister Fantastic ability, copying Sunken Palace's trigger twice.
Repeat from step 6.

1661-3713-5078-5268.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

116-5223-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kiora's Follower.
Activate one of the Kiora's Follower tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kiora's Follower token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

2334-2719-7009.description:
Activate Sakashima of a Thousand Faces using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Soulherder triggers, blinking Sakashima of a Thousand Faces. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

5220-6535-6797-6900.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Serrated Scorpion.
When Serrated Scorpion dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Serrated Scorpion from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Serrated Scorpion trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Cast Serrated Scorpion from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

997-4375-5361.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Auton Soldier enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Auton Soldier.
Resolve the Auton Soldier trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

413-628-6487.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Canker Abomination.
When Canker Abomination dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Canker Abomination enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Canker Abomination trigger, putting a number of -1/-1 counters on it equal to the number of creatures an opponent controls.
If the opponent had seven or more creatures, Canker Abomination will die as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness. If this occurs, repeat steps 2 through 5 infinitely.
Otherwise, resolve the Blasting Station ability, and repeat from step 1.

Pemmin's Aura attached to Fatestitcher.
Fatestitcher does not have summoning sickness.

Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
High Tide triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping the Island.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Fatestitcher.
Repeat from step 2

During the opponent's turn, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1849-2457-4289-4772.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.

1636-4644-5970-6219.description:

When the Demon enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Ritual Chamber.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

222-527-2511-4885.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.

Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

When Basking Broodscale enters the battlefield as a Bear due to Kudo, Ayula triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Basking Broodscale.

When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a Bear due to Kudo, Ayula triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 3.

428-2736-3604-5096.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal exactly 2 damage to an opponent.
428-2736-3604-5096.description:

Cast Ghyrson Starn by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Ghyrson Starn enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Ghyrson Starn that isn't legendary.
Deal 2 damage to that opponent by any method, reduced to 1 due to Protection of the Hekma.
Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The token Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 7.

Cast Instill Energy by paying {G}, targeting the legendary creature.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Leyline Immersion to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve Instill Energy, attaching it to the legendary creature.
Activate Instill Energy by paying {0}, untapping the legendary creature.
Cast Leyline Immersion by paying {3}{G}, targeting the legendary creature.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Instill Energy to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve Leyline Immersion, attaching it to the legendary creature.
Repeat.

751-3147-3314-3875.description:

Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Azorius Chancery from your hand onto the battlefield.

Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

15-803-1339-2034.notablePrerequisites:
"Human" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.

Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Laid to Rest triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

924-2452-2577.description:
Activate Phyrexian Ghoul's ability by sacrificing Gravecrawler, giving Phyrexian Ghoul +2/+2 until end of turn.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {0}.
